definition: II. [ צוּק ] verb pour out, melt (|| יצק ); — Qal Perfect 3 plural (according to Thes and others) צָקוּן Isa 26:16 , but see below; Imperfect 3 masculine singular וְאֶבֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָׁה Job 28:2 (read perhaps יָצוּקוּ , see Bu ) and stone (ore, men ) melt it into copper ; צוּר יָצוּק עִמָּדִי פַּלְגֵישָֿׁ֑מֶן Job 29:6 the rock used to pour out beside me streams of oil. — Isa 26:16 (as above) must mean they poured out (uttered) a whisper ( לַחַשׁ ; i. e. prayer); but form most improbable; Koppe Gr Di Du and others propose צְקוֺן לַחַשׁ (from assumed צָקוֺן , I. צוק ) = constraint of (like that of) magic ; < Houb Kit צָֽעֲקוּ בְלַחַץ ׳ וגו , or Che Hpt צָעַקְנוּ מִלַּחַץ כִּי מוּסָֽרְךָ לָנוּ .

II. [צוּק] verb pour out, melt (|| יצק); —

Qal Perfect 3 plural (according to Thes and others) צָקוּן Isa 26:16, but see below; Imperfect 3 masculine singular וְאֶבֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָׁה Job 28:2 (read perhaps יָצוּקוּ, see Bu) and stone (ore, men) melt it into copper; צוּר יָצוּק עִמָּדִי פַּלְגֵישָֿׁ֑מֶן Job 29:6 the rock used to pour out beside me streams of oil. — Isa 26:16 (as above) must mean they poured out (uttered) a whisper (לַחַשׁ; i. e. prayer); but form most improbable; Koppe Gr Di Du and others propose צְקוֺן לַחַשׁ (from assumed צָקוֺן, I. צוק) = constraint of (like that of) magic; < Houb Kit צָֽעֲקוּ בְלַחַץ ׳וגו, or CheHpt צָעַקְנוּ מִלַּחַץ כִּי מוּסָֽרְךָ לָנוּ.
